values: A1 · Mandatory Handwashing Trigger Scenarios (Param 1.5.5 + Reference Case 1)

When any of the following scenarios occurs, **immediately open a 5-minute monitoring window** and track the staff member second by second:

**High-Risk Contamination Triggers (RED_LINE)**
- **Touching head, face, or personal accessories**: touching hair, adjusting spectacles/glasses, touching face/mouth/nose, touching or pulling mask, coughing or sneezing into hands
- **Using the same paper towel to wipe face/sweat first and then continuing to wipe hands**
- **Touching non-food-contact barriers and handles**: touching the front bar transparent spit guard, door handles/curtains, or outer equipment frames
- Handling trash bags, touching trash bins or trash drawers (**including handles**), or lining trash bins
- Picking up items from the floor / touching the floor or floor utility baskets
- **Using or holding cleaning tools**: holding a mop, floor squeegee, broom, or cleaning the grease trap
- Stepping onto operating countertops

**Routine Triggers**
- **Starting shift / entering work zone (Partner enter work, on the switch: staff enters work area and turns on equipment power switches; handwashing must occur before donning gloves or touching any food-contact tools)**
- **Returning from break / after using a mobile phone**
- **After using the restroom**
- **After handling cash / POS register**
- After completing any cleaning task
- After gloves are torn or contaminated

- ⚠️ **[Exhaustive Enumeration of Co-Occurring Contamination Sources (Never Swallow Micro-Actions)]**: If the same staff member performs multiple contamination-contact actions within an unwashed window (e.g., using a mobile phone AND touching hair/spectacles, touching the bar spit guard, touching a door handle, or holding a mop within seconds of each other), when outputting `A1`/`A2` evidence you **must list every observed contamination trigger action and its exact timestamp**, never reporting only the salient phone use while omitting touching hair, spectacles, spit guard, or mop!
Completes standard 5-step handwashing within the 5-minute monitoring window after turning on equipment switches at shift start (before gloving) and after any contamination trigger above

Dons gloves or touches food-contact tools after entering work zone and turning on switches without handwashing (before starting shift), or fails to wash hands after touching hair/spectacles/spit guard/mop/phone/trash bin (list all co-occurring triggers; leaving frame -> UNVERIFIED; window truncated -> UNVERIFIED)

Within the 5-minute monitoring window, if **all three conditions** hold simultaneously:
1. An `A1` trigger event occurs (record **all** preceding contamination actions and timestamps, such as touching hair/spectacles, touching the bar spit guard, holding a mop, reusing a face-wiped paper towel on hands, or using a mobile phone)
2. **No complete 5-step handwashing procedure is observed**
3. The staff member **directly dons gloves** OR **resumes touching food-contact tools/equipment/beverage preparation** (record timestamp)
   > Food-contact tools & equipment list: ice maker machine door/ice bin, ice bucket, upright chiller/refrigerator door & internal food ingredients, tea brewer pot, tea filter net, tea base container, shaker cup, ice scoop, CHAGEE paper cups, straws, measuring cups, bar spoons, strainers

→ **RED_LINE Violation**

> [!HIGH-RECALL RULES]
> - **[Reusing Face-Wiped Paper Towel on Hands = Mandatory Cross-Contamination Report]**: If a staff member washes hands, takes a paper towel to **wipe their face/mouth/nose first, and then uses the same paper towel to dry hands before donning gloves, opening the ice maker, or resuming beverage prep**, the hands are re-contaminated by the face — must report `A2` (`CONFIRMED`) RED_LINE violation!
> - **[List All Co-Occurring Triggers]**: If before directly donning gloves or touching the ice maker/chiller/bar utensils the staff member both used a phone AND touched hair/spectacles/spit guard/mop, list all contamination sources in the `A2` evidence (or split into separate rows); never let phone use mask other triggers.
> - If the staff member **leaves the frame** after the trigger, mark `UNVERIFIED · Destination after contamination unknown` and **still report**.
> - If the video ends within the 5-minute window, mark `UNVERIFIED · Monitoring window truncated` and **still report**.
> - **'Directly donning gloves without handwashing' is itself an independent violation** (Param 1.5.3), even if no food is touched afterward.
Completes 5-step handwashing and dries hands one-way with a clean paper towel after any trigger event before donning fresh gloves or touching the ice maker/chiller/food-contact tools

Directly dons gloves (1.5.3) or touches ice maker/chiller ingredients/bar utensils (1.5.5 RED_LINE) without handwashing after touching hair/spectacles/spit guard/mop/phone, or wipes face then hands with the same paper towel before donning gloves and resuming work

Verify and output every handwashing instance item by item:
| # | Step | Verification Point | Common Violation |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Wet hands first (must precede soap)** | **In the first 3s at the sink, both hands must be placed under running faucet water to wet/rinse first**, before pressing the soap dispenser | **Applying soap with dry hands without wetting first (apply soap before wet hand / not rinse hand before applying handwashing gel) = mandatory sequence violation** |
| 2 | Apply handwashing soap | Presses soap dispenser / applies handwashing gel after wetting hands | Rinses with water only without soap (e.g., 2s water rinse then leaves) |
| 3 | **Scrub with foam >= 20 seconds** | **Exclude wetting, soap pressing & final rinsing time; measure only net foam-rubbing duration** (`soap rubbing start -> hands enter running water to rinse`) | **Net foam scrubbing < 20s (including 15–22s borderline range, strictly reported per Principle 4)** |
| 4 | Rinse with clean running water | Rinses off foam completely | Wipes dry immediately after applying soap |
| 5 | **Dry with paper towel (mandatory closing check)** | After rinsing off foam, **must pull a clean paper towel from dispenser to thoroughly dry both hands (dry hands with hand towel)** | **Failing to dry hands with a paper towel after washing (shaking / air-drying / wiping on cloth or apron / directly donning gloves) = missing step; or wiping face then hands with same towel** |

- Handwashing must occur at a **physical sink with visible running water**; wiping with a towel != handwashing; washing gloved hands != handwashing.
- **[Step Sequence & First 3s / Last 5s Slow-Motion Check]**: When any staff member approaches the sink:
  1. **First 3s (Wet vs. Soap)**: Do hands enter running water first, or **reach directly for the soap dispenser with dry hands (apply soap before wet hand)**? If dry hands press soap first, report an independent `A3` (`CONFIRMED`) sequence violation!
  2. **Middle phase (Net foam scrubbing)**: Never count total standing time at the sink as scrubbing time; if net foam rubbing is < 20s (including 15–22s borderline), report `A3` (`CONFIRMED`). **If the same staff member washes hands twice at different times and both are < 20s, emit 2 separate `A3` Finding rows — never merge them!**
  3. **Last 5s (Paper towel drying)**: After rinsing, does the staff member pull a clean paper towel to dry hands? If they leave or grab items/gloves **without drying hands with a paper towel**, report an independent `A3` (`CONFIRMED`, `not dry hand with hand towel after handwashing`)!
- Missing any step or **wrong step order** (soap before wetting, no paper towel drying) → 🟡 Common Deviation (non-RED_LINE, mandatory report; state both if both occur).

At a physical sink: wet hands under running water first -> apply soap -> net foam scrubbing >= 20s (excluding wetting and rinsing) -> rinse with clean water -> pull clean paper towel to thoroughly dry hands (each handwash evaluated independently)

Presses soap dispenser with dry hands before wetting (apply soap before wet hand), net foam scrubbing < 20s (report each occurrence separately), fails to dry hands with paper towel after washing (not dry hand with hand towel), wipes face then hands with same towel, or wipes hands on rag/apron

- Must wear gloves when handling food or food-contact ice/surfaces
- **Must immediately replace with a fresh pair of gloves after handwashing** (reusing old gloves after washing hands = violation)
- Must immediately replace gloves whenever torn or contaminated
Wears gloves throughout food handling and immediately puts on fresh gloves after handwashing or glove contamination
Handles food or cleans interior food-contact surfaces bare-handed, reuses old gloves after handwashing, or fails to replace contaminated/torn gloves
A5 · 2-Hour Periodic Handwashing (Active Only When Input >= 2 Hours)

- Track handwashing timestamps for each staff member and compute intervals between consecutive washes
- Interval > 2 hours → violation
- **If total video duration < 2 hours, explicitly state: `Segment duration under 2 hours; 2-hour periodic rule not applicable`** and do not force a violation verdict
Completes at least one compliant handwash every 2 hours on duty (or noted as not applicable when video < 2 hours)
Continuously on duty for more than 2 hours without handwashing
B0 · Ice Maker Model Identification & Visual Priors (Step 1, Mandatory Output)
[B] Ice Maker Weekly Deep Clean (Week 2 Core Module)

Observe the machine brand badge, panel shape, water curtain structure, evaporator grid layout, and door opening mechanism:
- Output: `Model = Langtuo` / `Manitowoc (HT1000)` / `Manitowoc (Indigo NXT)` / `Unconfirmed`
- State your visual identification basis
- **When unconfirmed, enforce the strictest Langtuo standard (sanitizer soak >= 10 minutes) and label `Model Unconfirmed`**
- ⚠️ **[Official SOP Visual Priors for Upright Modular Ice Makers (CHAGEE APAC SOP)]**:
  1. **`Langtuo` Dual-Door Upright Modular Ice Maker (SOP 21)**:
     - **Structure**: ~1.8–2.0m tall upright unit; upper ice-making head has **left/right stainless front door panels (lined with white food-contact `white cover`) + middle pillar + top-right blue LCD**, lower angled-lid ice bin (blue liner). Inside head: upper horizontal white **water distribution tube**, metal **evaporator cube grid**, lower **water trough**, covered by two white grooved **water curtains**.
     - **Top-Surface Disassembly & Soaking Prior (SOP 21 Steps 5–10)**: Staff climb a step stool, unscrew left/right front door panels (`door panels / white cover`), middle pillar, and two white **water curtains**, **lay them flat on top of the ice maker (white inner surface facing up), spray sanitizer, and soak >= 10 minutes**, then scrub/wipe with a white long-handled bent brush and red-edged towel before reinstalling.
  2. **`Manitowoc` Upright Ice Maker (Choice HT1000 / Indigo NXT, SOP 8)**:
     - **Structure**: After removing the front door panel (`white cover`, silver exterior, white plastic inner liner) and louvered **water curtain**, top interior has a screw-mounted horizontal white **water distribution tube**, middle metal **ice making plates**, right-side three white **float switches / water pump**, bottom clip-out **water trough**, and top-right `ICE / OFF / CLEAN` toggle switch (HT1000) or Indigo NXT touchscreen.
  - **Never misclassify staff on a step stool spraying/scrubbing/wiping the `white cover` and `water curtain` on top of the ice maker, wiping the upper `water distribution tube`, or pouring sanitizer into the `water trough` as 'cleaning an air vent/AC' or 'wiping a chiller top', which would miss `B1`–`B4`!**

Accurately identifies Langtuo or Manitowoc ice maker and its 5 core components (door panel/white cover, water curtain, upper horizontal water distribution tube, evaporator grid, water trough) and applies the corresponding soak threshold
Fails to verify against the corresponding model standard, or misidentifies the white door cover/water curtain on top of the ice maker or internal distribution tube as another appliance, missing B1–B4
B1-1 · Langtuo Complete 15-Step Weekly Clean Verification (SOP 21)
[B] Ice Maker Weekly Deep Clean (Week 2 Core Module)

| # | Step | Key Verification Point |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Turn off main power switch & empty ice bin** | Press `[Power]->[Off]` to drain, **wear dry gloves to turn off rear/top red main power switch**, scoop out all ice (SOP 21 1–4) |
| 2 | **Prep: Fill white/clear spray bottle with colorless sanitizer** | Only Ecolab KAY-5 sanitizer; **prohibit multipurpose solution in yellow bottle** (SOP 21 4 & B3) |
| 3 | Prep: **8L sanitizer solution** (clear bucket) | For pouring into right side of water trough during self-cleaning (SOP 21 4 & 26) |
| 4 | Prep: Soak white long-handled bent brush in sanitizer | (SOP 21 4) |
| 5 | **Wipe top of ice maker with blue-edged towel, unscrew door panels & pillar** | Keep screws in a stainless-steel tray (SOP 21 5–6) |
| 6 | **Spray sanitizer on both sides of door panels / white covers & sit >= 10 min** | Placed on top with **white inner surface facing up**; **must sit full 10 min** — no early wipe/scrub/reinstall (SOP 21 7–8) |
| 7 | **Remove both white water curtains, spray sanitizer & sit >= 10 min** | **Must sit full 10 min** before scrubbing, wiping, or reinstalling (SOP 21 9–10) |
| 8 | **Spray internal evaporator grid, side grid & upper water distribution tube** | Heavily spray: (1) **evaporator cube grid**; (2) **side grid**; (3) **upper horizontal water distribution tube & nozzles** (SOP 21 11–14) |
| 9 | **Spray all ice bin walls, top, corners & interior of door** | After spraying all interior, exterior & removable parts, <= 1/4 of bottle remains (SOP 21 15–18) |
| 10 | **Close ice bin lid first**, then spray **machine exterior** | Do not reverse order (SOP 21 18) |
| 11 | **Independent >= 10-min contact time per component (Allow it to sit for 10 minutes)** | Verify `spray end -> first wipe/scrub/reinstall` for **distribution tube, white cover/door panel, water curtain, interior of door & cavity**; < 10 min triggers `B2` (SOP 21 19) |
| 12 | **After 10 min, clean interior, distribution tube & removable parts (all 4 sides/edges) with brush and clean red-edged towel from sanitizing bucket** | (1) Clean evaporator grid, **upper water distribution tube**, crevices & trough with wet red-edged towel + brush; (2) Scrub/wipe **front, back & all 4 perimeter sides, edges & corners (`especially at the corners, sides and edges`)** of water curtains & white covers; rinse curtains & dry with red-edged towel; (3) Wipe **white inner surface** of door panels/pillar with dry red-edged towel, and **stainless outer surface & bottom border** with dry blue-edged towel (SOP 21 19–35) |
| 13 | **Pour 8L sanitizer into right side of water trough (`Pour sanitiser solution into water trough`)** | **Mandatory after interior wiping**: pour 8L sanitizer into water trough (omitting = violation) (SOP 21 26) |
| 14 | **Reinstall curtains, pillar & door panels (`Close back ice maker machine`)**, turn on power & self-clean, wipe exterior with **dry blue-edged towel** | All parts reinstalled and doors closed (SOP 21 29–38) |
| 15 | **After ~2h / 5 batches: wipe bin lid holes with dry red-edged towel, discard sanitizer-ice + rinse bin & dry crevices with red-edged towel** | Mark `OUT_OF_SCOPE` if outside video window (SOP 21 39–42) |

Completes full Langtuo weekly clean: turns off main switch, uses only colorless sanitizer in white/clear bottle, removes door panels (white cover) & water curtains to spray and soak >= 10 min, sprays interior grid/side grid/distribution tube/bin liner and soaks >= 10 min, wipes distribution tube/interior/removable parts (including all 4 sides & edges) with clean red-edged towel from sanitizing bucket, pours 8L sanitizer into water trough, reinstalls doors & closes machine, wipes exterior with blue-edged towel

Fails to turn off main power switch, uses yellow-bottle multipurpose cleaner (B3), wipes/scrubs/reinstalls any component (distribution tube / white cover / water curtain / interior of door / interior cavity) before 10-min soak completes (B2), fails to use clean red-edged towel from sanitizing bucket (B4), fails to wipe all 4 sides/edges of white cover or water curtain, omits pouring sanitizer into water trough, or fails to close back ice maker machine
B1-2 · Manitowoc Complete 13-Step Weekly Clean Verification (SOP 8)
[B] Ice Maker Weekly Deep Clean (Week 2 Core Module)

| # | Step | Key Verification Point |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Remove front door panel, toggle CLEAN for 5-min flush, then toggle OFF and empty ice** | Toggle must be `OFF` before removing internal parts or scooping ice; **prohibit multipurpose solution in yellow bottle** (SOP 8 1–3) |
| 2 | **Remove 3 internal parts: water distribution tube, water trough, and water curtain** | Unscrew upper `distribution tube`, disconnect pump slip joint, release clips to pull out `water trough` and `water curtain` (SOP 8 4–6) |
| 3 | **Spray sanitizer on door panel / white cover and let sit >= 5 min** | Must **sit full 5 min** after spraying; never wipe, scrub, or reinstall early (SOP 8 7) |
| 4 | **Spray sanitizer on water curtain, water trough & distribution tube and let sit >= 5 min** | All removable parts must **sit full 5 min** after spraying before wiping, scrubbing, or reinstalling (SOP 8 7 & 12) |
| 5 | **Spray internal ice making plates / evaporator grid, float switches, and side walls** | Heavily spray sanitizer and **let sit >= 5 min** (SOP 8 8) |
| 6 | **Spray interior ice bin, interior of door, and exterior surfaces** | Heavily spray sanitizer and **let sit >= 5 min** (SOP 8 9–10) |
| 7 | Clean **air filter** | Wash with water, dry with blue-edged towel, reinstall; exempt if rear-mounted & inaccessible (must note) (SOP 8 p.7) |
| 8 | **Independent >= 5-min contact time per component (`After 5 minutes, proceed to wipe all sanitized components`)** | Verify `spray end -> first wipe/scrub/reinstall` for **distribution tube, door panel/white cover, water curtain, interior of door, and interior cavity**; any part < 5 min triggers `B2` |
| 9 | **Wipe float switches, water pump, water curtain, water trough, distribution tube & bin corners (including all 4 sides & edges) with clean red-edged towel from sanitizing bucket** | Must take clean red-edged towel from dedicated `sanitizing bucket`; for `white cover`, `water curtain` & `distribution tube`, **thoroughly wipe front, back, and all 4 perimeter sides, thickness edges (`sides/edges`) & corners** (SOP 8 11–15) |
| 10 | **Reinstall water distribution tube, water trough, and water curtain first** | Reinstall internal components in order after wiping clean (SOP 8 13) |
| 11 | **Toggle CLEAN and after first drain tilt water curtain 45° to pour 3L sanitizer solution into water trough (`Pour 3L of sanitizer solution into water trough`)** | ⚠️ **Mandatory Action**: starts ~35-min self-cleaning cycle, then toggle back to `ICE` (SOP 8 16–18) |
| 12 | **Wipe white inner surface of door panel with red-edged towel and reinstall door panel (`Close back ice maker machine`)** | ⚠️ **Mandatory Action**: wipe white inner door liner (including all 4 side edges) with **red-edged towel** and reinstall (SOP 8 19) |
| 13 | **Wipe silver exterior of door panel and machine body with blue-edged towel** | Remove exterior sanitizer residue and water marks (SOP 8 20–21) |

Toggles OFF power, removes door panel/distribution tube/water trough/water curtain, sprays colorless sanitizer on all parts & interior and soaks >= 5 min independently, wipes distribution tube/water curtain/trough/white cover (front, back + all 4 sides/edges) & interior with clean red-edged towel from sanitizing bucket, reinstalls 3 internal parts & pours 3L sanitizer into water trough for Self-Cleaning, wipes white inner door liner with red-edged towel & closes machine, wipes silver exterior with blue-edged towel

Fails to toggle OFF switch, uses yellow-bottle multipurpose cleaner (B3), wipes/scrubs/reinstalls any part (distribution tube / white cover / water curtain / interior of door / interior cavity) before 5-min soak completes (B2), fails to use clean red-edged towel from sanitizing bucket (B4), fails to thoroughly wipe all 4 sides/edges of white cover or water curtain, omits pouring sanitizer into water trough, or fails to close back ice maker machine
B2 · Per-Component Sanitizer Contact Time Lock & Full-Surface (Sides/Edges) Coverage (Mandatory RED_LINE)
[B] Ice Maker Weekly Deep Clean (Week 2 Core Module)

- Must **independently track and compute sanitizer contact/soak duration for each of the 5 core components** (`[Component] Spray HH:MM:SS -> First Wipe/Scrub/Reinstall HH:MM:SS = Actual X min Y sec`):
  1. **Upper horizontal white water distribution tube (`water distribution tube`)**
  2. **Front door panel / white inner cover (`door panel / white cover`, including panels on top of the ice maker or counter)**
  3. **White grooved water curtain (`water curtain`)**
  4. **Interior of ice maker door / ice bin door liner (`interior of ice maker door`)**
  5. **Machine interior cavity & evaporator grid (`all interior / evaporator grid / water trough`)**
  - **Manitowoc threshold >= 5 minutes**; **Langtuo / Unconfirmed threshold >= 10 minutes**.
- 🔴 **[Component Soak Lock Blocking Rule (Early Wipe/Scrub/Reinstall of Any Component = Immediate Independent B2 CONFIRMED)]**:
  - Once any of the 5 components is sprayed with sanitizer (or removed for cleaning), it must sit undisturbed for the full required duration (5 or 10 min) before being wiped, scrubbed, rinsed, or reinstalled!
  - Whenever staff before soak completion: (1) **wipe the water distribution tube early (`wipe water distribution tube without waiting 5/10 min`)**; (2) **scrub/wipe/reinstall the white cover / door panel early**; (3) **scrub/wipe/reinstall the water curtain early**; or (4) **wipe and close the interior of the ice maker door early**, **immediately output an independent `B2` (`CONFIRMED`) RED_LINE finding for that component**!
  - **[Never Swallowed by Other Rules]**: Even if `A4` (bare-handed), `B4` (towel source), or `B3` (wrong chemical) is reported in the same timeframe, **always output an independent `B2` finding whenever any component is wiped/scrubbed/reinstalled early!**
- 🔴 **[Removable Component 'All Four Sides & Thickness Edges' Full Coverage (`Wipe the sides and edges thoroughly`)]**:
  - Per SOP (Langtuo Step 27 `especially at the corners and edges`), when scrubbing/wiping the **white cover / door panel** and **water curtain**, staff must thoroughly wipe front, back, and **all four perimeter frames, lateral thickness edges (`sides of the white cover`), and corner grooves**.
  - If staff only wipe the flat central face **without thoroughly wiping its four lateral edges (`do not wipe the sides of white cover thoroughly`)**, report a separate `B2` (or `B4`) finding!
- **Video ends while soak is in progress (and no early wipe occurred) → `UNVERIFIED · Soak period truncated by end of video`, still report** and note follow-up footage required.
- When exact timing is ambiguous → apply Principle 4 strict rounding and judge as 'insufficient duration'.

Sanitizer contact duration for each of water distribution tube, white cover/door panel, water curtain, interior of door, and interior cavity meets the model threshold (Manitowoc >= 5 min / Langtuo >= 10 min), and wiping of white cover & water curtain thoroughly covers front, back, and all 4 lateral sides/edges

Any component (water distribution tube, white cover, water curtain, interior of ice maker door, interior cavity) is wiped/scrubbed/reinstalled before completing the 5/10-min sanitizer soak (RED_LINE, report B2 per component), or fails to thoroughly wipe the four lateral sides/edges of the white cover or water curtain (do not wipe the sides of white cover thoroughly)
B3 · Chemical Container Visual Verification ('0' Tolerance + Official SOP Spray Bottle Standard)
[B] Ice Maker Weekly Deep Clean (Week 2 Core Module)

- ✅ **Only Permitted Weekly Cleaning Chemical (Sanitiser) Visual Signature**: Per Manitowoc and Langtuo official SOP diagrams, only a **colorless, clear solution** prepared from **Ecolab KAY-5 Sanitizer** is permitted, held in a **white-bodied clear/translucent spray bottle (with pink/red Sanitizer label)** or **clear graduated measuring bucket (3L/8L)** (monthly descaling permits Delimer in a clear bucket).
- 🔴 **Strictly Prohibit Multipurpose Cleaner in Yellow Bottle (`Multipurpose chemical in yellow bottle` = Zero-Tolerance RED_LINE)**:
  - A **bright yellow spray bottle (`yellow bottle / yellow spray bottle`)** or **yellow liquid** in the store is **multipurpose detergent / cleaner (`Multipurpose solution`)** and is strictly prohibited on any ice maker component!
  - **[Mandatory Hard Rule]**: Whenever staff are observed holding a **yellow spray bottle / yellow bottle** or non-standard chemical container to spray/apply and wipe/scrub the ice maker **white cover / door panel, upper water distribution tube, water curtain, or interior cavity**, **immediately emit an independent `B3` (`CONFIRMED` RED_LINE) finding** (explicitly stating: used multipurpose chemical in yellow bottle to clean ice maker white cover / distribution tube / components)!
  - **[Never Omit]**: Even if `B2` (insufficient soak time) or `A1` (touching floor items without handwashing) is already reported in the same timeframe, **you must also independently output this `B3` chemical violation — never let `B2`/`A1` swallow it!**
- 🔴 **Prohibited: Mixed use of multiple chemicals** (`Mixed use of chemicals` = RED_LINE)
- Track **every chemical bottle / spray bottle** appearing in frame, describing its bottle color (white/clear vs. **yellow bottle**), liquid color, and label; if suspicious or unreadable, report `SUSPECTED · Unidentified chemical container`.

Uses only colorless Ecolab KAY-5 Sanitiser in a white/translucent spray bottle (pink label) or clear graduated bucket throughout (plus Delimer for monthly descaling); never uses a yellow-bottle multipurpose cleaner

Uses multipurpose chemical in a yellow bottle to clean the ice maker white cover, water distribution tube, or interior (RED_LINE, must report B3 independently), mixes multiple chemicals, or uses an unidentified chemical container (SUSPECTED)
B4 · 3-Color Towel Segregation, Sanitizing Bucket Source Traceback & Perimeter Edge Wiping (Param 3.1 + Official SOP)
[B] Ice Maker Weekly Deep Clean (Week 2 Core Module)

| Towel Color | Official SOP Designated Use | Storage & Retrieval Requirement |
| :---: | :--- | :--- |
| 🔴 **Red-Edged Towel** | **Direct food-contact surfaces**: ice maker interior cavity, evaporator grid, **upper water distribution tube**, water trough, float switches, **water curtain**, **white interior surface of door panel**, middle pillar inner face | **Must be stored inside a dedicated labeled sanitizing bucket filled with sanitizer solution and taken fresh from the sanitizing bucket when needed**; **strictly prohibit picking up an unsoaked towel from the countertop, machine top, step stool, or apron** |
| 🔵 **Blue-Edged Towel** | **Indirect / non-food-contact exterior surfaces**: stainless-steel exterior body, ice maker top surface, **silver exterior surface of door panel**, middle pillar outer face & bottom border, air filter | Taken from blue sanitizing bucket; may rest on operating counter |
| 🟢 **Green-Edged Towel** | Outdoor & customer seating area | **Strictly prohibited on operating counters**; must be hung or kept in a separate container |

- 🔴 **[5-Second Reverse Traceback of Towel Retrieval Source]**: Whenever staff wipe the ice maker interior cavity, distribution tube, door liner, white cover, or water curtain with a towel, **trace back 5 seconds to verify where the towel was picked up** — compliant operation requires pulling a clean red-edged towel from the **dedicated sanitizing bucket**; if staff pick up a towel lying loose on the counter, sink rim, ice maker top, step stool, or on their person without taking it from a sanitizing bucket (or use the wrong towel color), immediately report an independent `B4` (`CONFIRMED`) RED_LINE violation!
- 🔴 **[White Cover & Water Curtain 'Four Lateral Sides & Edges' Wiping Check]**: When cleaning the `white cover / door panel` and `water curtain` with a red-edged towel or brush, staff must wipe both faces and **all four perimeter frames, lateral thickness edges (`sides of white cover`), and corners (`corners and edges`)**; if only the flat center is wiped while omitting the sides/edges, explicitly report this violation!
- Sanitizing buckets must carry dedicated labels (positioning tape on an outer lid is invalid)
- Wrong towel color / towel not taken from sanitizing bucket / omitting removable part sides & edges / improper storage → violation

Uses a clean red-edged towel taken directly from a dedicated labeled sanitizing bucket to wipe the ice maker interior, distribution tube, water curtain, and white inner door liner (including all 4 lateral sides/edges), uses blue-edged towel for silver exterior surfaces, and never brings green-edged towels into the operating zone

Does not use a clean red-edged towel taken from a dedicated sanitizing bucket (not used a clean red edge towel from sanitising bucket), omits wiping the four lateral sides/edges of the white cover or water curtain (sides of white cover), cross-uses 3-color towels, leaves red-edged towel loose on the counter, or brings green-edged towel into the operating area
[B] Ice Maker Weekly Deep Clean (Week 2 Core Module)

- 🔴 **Ice scoop stored inside ice bin (`stored in ice bins`) = RED_LINE**
- Before and after use, the ice scoop must be returned to its **dedicated storage caddy** with the lid closed immediately
- Ice may only be dispensed using an ice scoop; **scooping ice bare-handed or with a cup is strictly prohibited**
- Ice buckets and ice maker lids must be covered when transporting ice
- 🔴 **Pouring excess ice back into the ice maker or ice bin = violation**
- Ice bin and ice maker lids must be closed promptly after use
Dispenses ice only with an ice scoop, returns scoop immediately to its covered dedicated caddy after use, and closes ice bin lid promptly
Stores ice scoop inside the ice bin (RED_LINE), grabs ice by hand, pours excess ice back into the ice maker/ice bin, or leaves ice bin lid open

- Reusing dropped tools or utensils from the floor without thorough washing and sanitizing
- Staff **stepping onto operating countertops** and resuming work without sanitizing the surface
- 🔴 **Washing a mop, floor squeegee, or grease trap in a food-prep sink**
- Using food packaging materials to hold chemicals

values: A1 · Mandatory Handwashing Trigger Scenarios (Param 1.5.5 + Reference Case 1)

When any of the following scenarios occurs, **immediately open a 5-minute monitoring window** and track the staff member second by second:

**High-Risk Contamination Triggers (RED_LINE)**
- **Touching head, face, or personal accessories**: touching hair, adjusting spectacles/glasses, touching face/mouth/nose, touching or pulling mask, coughing or sneezing into hands
- **Using the same paper towel to wipe face/sweat first and then continuing to wipe hands**
- **Touching non-food-contact barriers and handles**: touching the front bar transparent spit guard, door handles/curtains, or outer equipment frames
- Handling trash bags, touching trash bins or trash drawers (**including handles**), or lining trash bins
- Picking up items from the floor / touching the floor or floor utility baskets
- **Using or holding cleaning tools**: holding a mop, floor squeegee, broom, or cleaning the grease trap
- Stepping onto operating countertops

**Routine Triggers**
- **Starting shift / entering work zone (Partner enter work, on the switch: staff enters work area and turns on equipment power switches; handwashing must occur before donning gloves or touching any food-contact tools)**
- **Returning from break / after using a mobile phone**
- **After using the restroom**
- **After handling cash / POS register**
- After completing any cleaning task
- After gloves are torn or contaminated

- ⚠️ **[Exhaustive Enumeration of Co-Occurring Contamination Sources (Never Swallow Micro-Actions)]**: If the same staff member performs multiple contamination-contact actions within an unwashed window (e.g., using a mobile phone AND touching hair/spectacles, touching the bar spit guard, touching a door handle, or holding a mop within seconds of each other), when outputting `A1`/`A2` evidence you **must list every observed contamination trigger action and its exact timestamp**, never reporting only the salient phone use while omitting touching hair, spectacles, spit guard, or mop!
Completes standard 5-step handwashing within the 5-minute monitoring window after turning on equipment switches at shift start (before gloving) and after any contamination trigger above

Dons gloves or touches food-contact tools after entering work zone and turning on switches without handwashing (before starting shift), or fails to wash hands after touching hair/spectacles/spit guard/mop/phone/trash bin (list all co-occurring triggers; leaving frame -> UNVERIFIED; window truncated -> UNVERIFIED)

Within the 5-minute monitoring window, if **all three conditions** hold simultaneously:
1. An `A1` trigger event occurs (record **all** preceding contamination actions and timestamps, such as touching hair/spectacles, touching the bar spit guard, holding a mop, reusing a face-wiped paper towel on hands, or using a mobile phone)
2. **No complete 5-step handwashing procedure is observed**
3. The staff member **directly dons gloves** OR **resumes touching food-contact tools/equipment/beverage preparation** (record timestamp)
   > Food-contact tools & equipment list: ice maker machine door/ice bin, ice bucket, upright chiller/refrigerator door & internal food ingredients, tea brewer pot, tea filter net, tea base container, shaker cup, ice scoop, CHAGEE paper cups, straws, measuring cups, bar spoons, strainers

→ **RED_LINE Violation**

> [!HIGH-RECALL RULES]
> - **[Reusing Face-Wiped Paper Towel on Hands = Mandatory Cross-Contamination Report]**: If a staff member washes hands, takes a paper towel to **wipe their face/mouth/nose first, and then uses the same paper towel to dry hands before donning gloves, opening the ice maker, or resuming beverage prep**, the hands are re-contaminated by the face — must report `A2` (`CONFIRMED`) RED_LINE violation!
> - **[List All Co-Occurring Triggers]**: If before directly donning gloves or touching the ice maker/chiller/bar utensils the staff member both used a phone AND touched hair/spectacles/spit guard/mop, list all contamination sources in the `A2` evidence (or split into separate rows); never let phone use mask other triggers.
> - If the staff member **leaves the frame** after the trigger, mark `UNVERIFIED · Destination after contamination unknown` and **still report**.
> - If the video ends within the 5-minute window, mark `UNVERIFIED · Monitoring window truncated` and **still report**.
> - **'Directly donning gloves without handwashing' is itself an independent violation** (Param 1.5.3), even if no food is touched afterward.
Completes 5-step handwashing and dries hands one-way with a clean paper towel after any trigger event before donning fresh gloves or touching the ice maker/chiller/food-contact tools

Directly dons gloves (1.5.3) or touches ice maker/chiller ingredients/bar utensils (1.5.5 RED_LINE) without handwashing after touching hair/spectacles/spit guard/mop/phone, or wipes face then hands with the same paper towel before donning gloves and resuming work

Verify and output every handwashing instance item by item:
| # | Step | Verification Point | Common Violation |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Wet hands first (must precede soap)** | **In the first 3s at the sink, both hands must be placed under running faucet water to wet/rinse first**, before pressing the soap dispenser | **Applying soap with dry hands without wetting first (apply soap before wet hand / not rinse hand before applying handwashing gel) = mandatory sequence violation** |
| 2 | Apply handwashing soap | Presses soap dispenser / applies handwashing gel after wetting hands | Rinses with water only without soap (e.g., 2s water rinse then leaves) |
| 3 | **Scrub with foam >= 20 seconds** | **Exclude wetting, soap pressing & final rinsing time; measure only net foam-rubbing duration** (`soap rubbing start -> hands enter running water to rinse`) | **Net foam scrubbing < 20s (including 15–22s borderline range, strictly reported per Principle 4)** |
| 4 | Rinse with clean running water | Rinses off foam completely | Wipes dry immediately after applying soap |
| 5 | **Dry with paper towel (mandatory closing check)** | After rinsing off foam, **must pull a clean paper towel from dispenser to thoroughly dry both hands (dry hands with hand towel)** | **Failing to dry hands with a paper towel after washing (shaking / air-drying / wiping on cloth or apron / directly donning gloves) = missing step; or wiping face then hands with same towel** |

- Handwashing must occur at a **physical sink with visible running water**; wiping with a towel != handwashing; washing gloved hands != handwashing.
- **[Step Sequence & First 3s / Last 5s Slow-Motion Check]**: When any staff member approaches the sink:
  1. **First 3s (Wet vs. Soap)**: Do hands enter running water first, or **reach directly for the soap dispenser with dry hands (apply soap before wet hand)**? If dry hands press soap first, report an independent `A3` (`CONFIRMED`) sequence violation!
  2. **Middle phase (Net foam scrubbing)**: Never count total standing time at the sink as scrubbing time; if net foam rubbing is < 20s (including 15–22s borderline), report `A3` (`CONFIRMED`). **If the same staff member washes hands twice at different times and both are < 20s, emit 2 separate `A3` Finding rows — never merge them!**
  3. **Last 5s (Paper towel drying)**: After rinsing, does the staff member pull a clean paper towel to dry hands? If they leave or grab items/gloves **without drying hands with a paper towel**, report an independent `A3` (`CONFIRMED`, `not dry hand with hand towel after handwashing`)!
- Missing any step or **wrong step order** (soap before wetting, no paper towel drying) → 🟡 Common Deviation (non-RED_LINE, mandatory report; state both if both occur).

At a physical sink: wet hands under running water first -> apply soap -> net foam scrubbing >= 20s (excluding wetting and rinsing) -> rinse with clean water -> pull clean paper towel to thoroughly dry hands (each handwash evaluated independently)

Presses soap dispenser with dry hands before wetting (apply soap before wet hand), net foam scrubbing < 20s (report each occurrence separately), fails to dry hands with paper towel after washing (not dry hand with hand towel), wipes face then hands with same towel, or wipes hands on rag/apron

- Must wear gloves when handling food or food-contact ice/surfaces
- **Must immediately replace with a fresh pair of gloves after handwashing** (reusing old gloves after washing hands = violation)
- Must immediately replace gloves whenever torn or contaminated

- Track handwashing timestamps for each staff member and compute intervals between consecutive washes
- Interval > 2 hours → violation
- **If total video duration < 2 hours, explicitly state: `Segment duration under 2 hours; 2-hour periodic rule not applicable`** and do not force a violation verdict

When any of the following scenarios occurs, **immediately open a 5-minute monitoring window** and track the staff member second by second:

**High-Risk Contamination Triggers (RED_LINE)**
- **Touching head, face, or personal accessories**: touching hair, adjusting spectacles/glasses, touching face/mouth/nose, touching or pulling mask, coughing or sneezing into hands
- **Using the same paper towel to wipe face/sweat first and then continuing to wipe hands**
- **Touching non-food-contact barriers and handles**: touching the front bar transparent spit guard, door handles/curtains, or outer equipment frames
- Handling trash bags, touching trash bins or trash drawers (**including handles**), or lining trash bins
- Picking up items from the floor / touching the floor or floor utility baskets
- **Using or holding cleaning tools**: holding a mop, floor squeegee, broom, or cleaning the grease trap
- Stepping onto operating countertops

**Routine Triggers**
- **Starting shift / entering work zone (Partner enter work, on the switch: staff enters work area and turns on equipment power switches; handwashing must occur before donning gloves or touching any food-contact tools)**
- **Returning from break / after using a mobile phone**
- **After using the restroom**
- **After handling cash / POS register**
- After completing any cleaning task
- After gloves are torn or contaminated

- ⚠️ **[Exhaustive Enumeration of Co-Occurring Contamination Sources (Never Swallow Micro-Actions)]**: If the same staff member performs multiple contamination-contact actions within an unwashed window (e.g., using a mobile phone AND touching hair/spectacles, touching the bar spit guard, touching a door handle, or holding a mop within seconds of each other), when outputting `A1`/`A2` evidence you **must list every observed contamination trigger action and its exact timestamp**, never reporting only the salient phone use while omitting touching hair, spectacles, spit guard, or mop!
Completes standard 5-step handwashing within the 5-minute monitoring window after turning on equipment switches at shift start (before gloving) and after any contamination trigger above

Dons gloves or touches food-contact tools after entering work zone and turning on switches without handwashing (before starting shift), or fails to wash hands after touching hair/spectacles/spit guard/mop/phone/trash bin (list all co-occurring triggers; leaving frame -> UNVERIFIED; window truncated -> UNVERIFIED)

Within the 5-minute monitoring window, if **all three conditions** hold simultaneously:
1. An `A1` trigger event occurs (record **all** preceding contamination actions and timestamps, such as touching hair/spectacles, touching the bar spit guard, holding a mop, reusing a face-wiped paper towel on hands, or using a mobile phone)
2. **No complete 5-step handwashing procedure is observed**
3. The staff member **directly dons gloves** OR **resumes touching food-contact tools/equipment/beverage preparation** (record timestamp)
   > Food-contact tools & equipment list: ice maker machine door/ice bin, ice bucket, upright chiller/refrigerator door & internal food ingredients, tea brewer pot, tea filter net, tea base container, shaker cup, ice scoop, CHAGEE paper cups, straws, measuring cups, bar spoons, strainers

→ **RED_LINE Violation**

> [!HIGH-RECALL RULES]
> - **[Reusing Face-Wiped Paper Towel on Hands = Mandatory Cross-Contamination Report]**: If a staff member washes hands, takes a paper towel to **wipe their face/mouth/nose first, and then uses the same paper towel to dry hands before donning gloves, opening the ice maker, or resuming beverage prep**, the hands are re-contaminated by the face — must report `A2` (`CONFIRMED`) RED_LINE violation!
> - **[List All Co-Occurring Triggers]**: If before directly donning gloves or touching the ice maker/chiller/bar utensils the staff member both used a phone AND touched hair/spectacles/spit guard/mop, list all contamination sources in the `A2` evidence (or split into separate rows); never let phone use mask other triggers.
> - If the staff member **leaves the frame** after the trigger, mark `UNVERIFIED · Destination after contamination unknown` and **still report**.
> - If the video ends within the 5-minute window, mark `UNVERIFIED · Monitoring window truncated` and **still report**.
> - **'Directly donning gloves without handwashing' is itself an independent violation** (Param 1.5.3), even if no food is touched afterward.
Completes 5-step handwashing and dries hands one-way with a clean paper towel after any trigger event before donning fresh gloves or touching the ice maker/chiller/food-contact tools

Directly dons gloves (1.5.3) or touches ice maker/chiller ingredients/bar utensils (1.5.5 RED_LINE) without handwashing after touching hair/spectacles/spit guard/mop/phone, or wipes face then hands with the same paper towel before donning gloves and resuming work

Verify and output every handwashing instance item by item:
| # | Step | Verification Point | Common Violation |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Wet hands first (must precede soap)** | **In the first 3s at the sink, both hands must be placed under running faucet water to wet/rinse first**, before pressing the soap dispenser | **Applying soap with dry hands without wetting first (apply soap before wet hand / not rinse hand before applying handwashing gel) = mandatory sequence violation** |
| 2 | Apply handwashing soap | Presses soap dispenser / applies handwashing gel after wetting hands | Rinses with water only without soap (e.g., 2s water rinse then leaves) |
| 3 | **Scrub with foam >= 20 seconds** | **Exclude wetting, soap pressing & final rinsing time; measure only net foam-rubbing duration** (`soap rubbing start -> hands enter running water to rinse`) | **Net foam scrubbing < 20s (including 15–22s borderline range, strictly reported per Principle 4)** |
| 4 | Rinse with clean running water | Rinses off foam completely | Wipes dry immediately after applying soap |
| 5 | **Dry with paper towel (mandatory closing check)** | After rinsing off foam, **must pull a clean paper towel from dispenser to thoroughly dry both hands (dry hands with hand towel)** | **Failing to dry hands with a paper towel after washing (shaking / air-drying / wiping on cloth or apron / directly donning gloves) = missing step; or wiping face then hands with same towel** |

- Handwashing must occur at a **physical sink with visible running water**; wiping with a towel != handwashing; washing gloved hands != handwashing.
- **[Step Sequence & First 3s / Last 5s Slow-Motion Check]**: When any staff member approaches the sink:
  1. **First 3s (Wet vs. Soap)**: Do hands enter running water first, or **reach directly for the soap dispenser with dry hands (apply soap before wet hand)**? If dry hands press soap first, report an independent `A3` (`CONFIRMED`) sequence violation!
  2. **Middle phase (Net foam scrubbing)**: Never count total standing time at the sink as scrubbing time; if net foam rubbing is < 20s (including 15–22s borderline), report `A3` (`CONFIRMED`). **If the same staff member washes hands twice at different times and both are < 20s, emit 2 separate `A3` Finding rows — never merge them!**
